motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Rezoning Certain Lands Known as Corrigan Farms
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, rezoning certain lands known as Corrigan Farms. Councilmember Huish seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: An Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Corrigan Farms Development Agreement
motions.motion: Councilmember Wright moved to adopt an Ordinance of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Approving the Corrigan Farms Development Agreement. Councilmember Clark seconded the motion.

motions.item_title: A Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal Application to Proceed and Directing Staff to Begin the Notice and Public Hearing Process for a Portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108, Designated as “Significant Real Property” Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060.
motions.motion: Councilmember Wood moved to table a Resolution of Eagle Mountain City, Utah, Authorizing the Land Disposal Application to proceed and directing staff to begin the notice and public hearing process for a portion of Utah County Parcel No. 38:257:0108, Designated as “Significant Real Property” Pursuant to Eagle Mountain Municipal Code 3.30.060 , and to direct the Community Services Board to review all open space between houses as part of th is application . Councilmember Whiting seconded the motion.
